verdict.rationale: Deploying a vector database or lakehouse on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator is a fair axis for LanceDB. The evidence pack never mentions Kubernetes, Helm, or an operator. Storage docs cover backends such as NVMe, EBS, EFS and S3-compatible stores, and Enterprise docs cover authentication, but neither describes a Kubernetes deployment mode.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
